title: Titanium VonG Tip by DynaVap
description:
Titanium VonG Tip
Titanium’s biggest feature is how it takes on heat. With this tip you can expect a fast heat up time and will also cool down faster when compared to the stainless steel type tips. This is both an advantage and disadvantage depending on how you look at it. But no matter how you look at it, this tip will produce a satisfying experience once mastered.
Dynavap describes this tip as “A
Nona notched completely contoured extraction chamber
that doubles as a built in grinder sits atop a
trisected 5 fin profile
allowing
for faster heat exchange. Contained inside the extraction chamber is Dynavaps two position
Adjust-a-Bowl feature
that allows you to adjust the size of the dosing chamber to your needs”.
Included
1 x Titanium VonG Tip
